record.question: Which section of the IT Act deals with punishment for hacking?
record.explanation: Section66 is the best listed provision for the computer-related criminal offences commonly called hacking in exam shorthand. Precision note: the amended provision is titled Computer related offences and concerns relevant Section43 acts committed dishonestly or fraudulently. Not all activity loosely called hacking is automatically an offence; the applicable facts and statutory conditions matter. This is a dated examination explanation, not personal legal advice. Verified solution (unofficial); original printed source and technical explanation audited26October2026. References: https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/1999/1/A2000-21%20%281%29.pdf
